action.name: Green Beans Avatar Extension
action.description: Provide the Green Beans project default profile picture and avatar creator using supplied String Bean / Bean Pod artwork, optional Ball Cap headwear, a selectable background color, and trait preview icons.

user_actions.name: Create Green Beans Avatar
user_actions.description: Create and apply a Green Beans profile avatar by choosing Bean Type, Headwear, and Background Color.

core.user.profile.avatar.label: Green Beans
core.user.profile.avatar.description: Overrides the automatic LOOM default with the supplied Green Beans default avatar and provides a Green Beans creator with Bean Type, Headwear, and Background Color traits. Trait previews can use dedicated icons.

admin_settings.title: Green Beans Avatar Extension
admin_settings.description: Project-provided default avatar and creator artwork are owned by the Green Beans project module. Creator traits currently include Bean Type, Headwear, and Background Color, with dedicated preview icons.
